items.title: Howard Levy interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 11, 2025
items.q: my teacher would go, “Wait a minute, it doesn’t sound wrong but that’s not Schubert”

ctx.x: Did you have piano teachers who – did you stray from the compositions you were supposed to be playing during lessons and have piano teachers saying like, "What are you doing there? You can't do that.”

Oh yes. Because when I was a kid and studying at Manhattan School you know they had these student concerts. And so a lot of us would be assigned the same pieces. And you know I would hear the stuff that the other kids played. And I’d get to a passage in a piece that I’d heard before and go, “God, this is hard to read, I think it goes like this.” You know. So I would never play wrong notes, but I would be playing over the correct changes but I would you know, have my own little inner voicings, my own little…
Yeah. Well the fact that you recognized the changes that Schubert was using I think is significant anyway.
